attacks.name: Tactical Takedown
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!critical| |*Tranquilized|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§root§Root| special condition.
|!critical| |!wild| |*Bringing You In|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Push the defender Toward this character |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Headshot
steps: If the target character is not within |!range| 3 and does not benefit from Cover, if this attack would deal |!damage|, increase the amount dealt by 2.
|!critical| |*Concussion|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

superPowers.name: Shot Caller
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 4 and Advance it |!movement_small|. Then the chosen character gains 1 |!power|. A character can be affected by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Want My Help? Pay Up.
superPowers.body: When another allied character within |!range| 4 of this character makes an attack, during the |*Create Attack Dice Pool| step of the attack, this character may use this superpower. The allied character loses 2 |!power|. If it does, this character gains 1 |!power|, and the allied character adds 1 die to its attack roll. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Sniper Nest
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, if this character is overlapping a terrain feature of Size 3 or more and the attacking character is not overlapping the same terrain feature, this character adds 2 dice to its defense roll.
